label: Продолжать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for продолжать (to continue).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Продолжаю' is the я-form with the -ю ending. Продолжать is imperfective and often governs another infinitive, here 'учить'.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Продолжаешь' shows the -ешь ending. The verb takes the imperfective infinitive 'работать' to mean to keep on working.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Продолжает' is the он-form ending in -ет. Here it takes a noun object, 'свой долгий путь' in the accusative.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Продолжаем' shows the мы-ending -ем. 'Нашу беседу' is the accusative object of the ongoing action.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Продолжают' closes the present ladder with the -ют ending and governs the infinitive 'строить'.
Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Продолжал' is the masculine singular past of imperfective продолжать. It governs the infinitive 'читать' to stress an uninterrupted process.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Продолжала' adds the feminine -а ending. The infinitive 'улыбаться' shows the construction продолжать plus infinitive.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Продолжали' is the plural past ending in -и. 'Играть' is the dependent infinitive, 'во дворе' prepositional.
Strategic focus: Imperfective compound future. 'Будем продолжать' joins 'будем' with the infinitive; продолжать is imperfective. The perfective partner продолжить exists for a single resumption.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Продолжай' is the informal command of продолжать, here in the fixed idiom 'в том же духе', meaning keep it up.
